name: Orbit AI - Phase 4 - Front Door Audit refresh (W4.5)

nodes.name: 1st of month at 5am
nodes.notes: 05 §9 names 'Front Door Audit refresh' with a trigger of 'Schedule, Stage = Live Client' but no refresh CADENCE - monthly is this pass's own judgment call (a website/AI-answer-engine-readiness score plausibly drifting week to week isn't useful to re-check that often, and not for a full year either), not brief-specified.

nodes.name: Fetch active Contract
nodes.notes: Needs the Contract's locationIds - a Front Door Audit is per-Location (CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md), and Company itself doesn't carry the site list.

nodes.name: Split Locations
nodes.notes: ASSUMES the Contract list response's first row is the active Contract found and the field is a plain 'locationIds' array on the current item - same shape as contract-amendment-flow.workflow.json's own handling.

nodes.name: Fetch Location
nodes.notes: Needed for the Location's CURRENT frontDoorAuditScore before it gets overwritten below - the whole point of this workflow is detecting a meaningful change, not just re-stamping a number.

nodes.name: Call Front Door Audit
nodes.notes: Same named-placeholder service W1.1's own Front Door Audit call uses (workflows/README.md: the 10 weighted categories and their scoring aren't specified anywhere, so there's nothing real to call yet) - this workflow is real, ready wiring for when that service exists, not blocked on anything specific to REFRESHING versus the initial audit.

nodes.name: Write refreshed score

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ frontDoorAuditScore: $json.newScore, frontDoorAuditReportUrl: $json.reportUrl, frontDoorAuditRefreshedAt: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

nodes.notes: frontDoorAuditRefreshedAt is new this pass (CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md's Location object) - distinguishes 'the original audit from lead intake' from 'a live client's periodic refresh,' so a future workflow can tell whether a score is fresh without re-deriving it from Company.status.

nodes.name: Alert: Front Door Audit score changed

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: $('Compute score delta').item.json.delta < 0 ? 'warning' : 'info', source: 'front-door-audit-refresh', message: $('Compute score delta').item.json.locationName + "'s Front Door Audit score " + ($('Compute score delta').item.json.delta < 0 ? 'dropped' : 'improved') + ' by ' + Math.abs($('Compute score delta').item.json.delta) + ' points (' + $('Compute score delta').item.json.previousScore + ' -> ' + $('Compute score delta').item.json.newScore + ').', linkUrl: ($env.TWENTY_CRM_BASE_URL || '') + '/objects/location/' + $('Compute score delta').item.json.locationId }) }}

nodes.notes: 'Produces a retention/upsell proof point, not itself an external send' per 05 §9's own Gate description - a regression is a retention risk worth a CX rep's attention (warning severity, routes to #cx-retention via alertRouting.ts), an improvement is a genuine upsell/testimonial proof point (info severity, same channel).

main.node: Alert: Front Door Audit score changed
